revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2023-25 revenue grew ~0.4% then ~2.3%; mature staples assume low-to-mid single digit growth from pricing/volume recovery, fading to 3.5%.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 12.2% (11498/93925), FY2024 14.0%, FY2023 13.1%; assume partial recovery to 13.5%, near 3-yr average of 13.1% plus modest productivity gains.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate normalized US large-cap staples effective rate; FY2025 pretax 10,244 vs. NI 8,240 implies ~20% (10-K 0000077476-26-000007). Not separately verified.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2023-25 capex 6.0%, 5.8%, 4.7% of revenue; 5.0% reflects ongoing investment, above D&A.

wacc.source: CAPM: rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06); ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16); unlevered beta 0.575 (Damodaran Beverage (Soft) US cash-corrected) relevered at industry D/E 0.206 (no share price available for PEP market D/E) and 21% tax = 0.669; Ke 7.84%; pre-tax Kd 5.29% (Damodaran), after-tax ~4.2%; weights 82.9/17.1 => ~7.2%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP growth and below the 4.86% risk-free rate; mature staples franchise.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 49,182 (LT 42,321 + current 6,861) - cash 9,159 - ST investments 371; 10-K 0000077476-26-000007
